content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency breach detected for customer evermore-analytics (dedicated pool: evermore-euw1). p99=2.9s (SLO=1.0s). Error rate stable. Paging on-call @tilly.
tilly: Ack. I'm on it — pulling dashboards. Can someone paste the pool topology?
maya: I'm in. Seeing sustained tail at backend workers, CPU spikes on a subset of GPUs in eu-west-1.
samir: On-call takeover in 2m if needed. Any recent deploys to that pool?
luis: No deploys in last 6h from customer side. Customer reported slow responses in support thread.
olivia: I've DM'd product about customer impact and scheduled a 10:30 UTC bridge with Evermore contact.
evermore-sre: Confirming user-visible latency since ~09:12 UTC. A few requests time out at 5s. No config changes on our end.
tilly: Good data. Quick checklist: 1) isolate noisy tenants 2) scale dedicated pool 3) failover non-critical traffic to hosted. I'm going to run per-tenant qps check.
maya: Running query: `select tenant_id, p95, p99, qps from metrics where pool='evermore-euw1' and last=15m;`
maya: Results: tenant-42 p99=5.2s qps=18 (normal), tenant-7 p99=1.05s qps=120 (spike), shared routes p99=2.9s qps=220. Tenant-7 looks suspect but qps isn't huge — likely CPU-bound.
samir: Can we confirm kernel/quantization fallback on those workers? Maybe some instances reverted to float32 by mistake.
maya: Checking node labels and model variant: 6 nodes are running fallback variant `redwood-small-fp32`. Others on `redwood-small-q4`.
tilly: Bingo. Who flipped those? Any autoscaler churn?
luis: Autoscaler logs show 3 node restarts starting 09:05 UTC due to OOMs on worker pods. Restarted into default image which lacks q4 runtime flag.
tilly: Alright mitigation plan A: attempt partial eviction of tenant-7 to reduce load and restart affected nodes with q4 runtime. Plan B: scale pool + route low-priority traffic to hosted API. Which do we execute first?
samir: Do eviction first (less global impact) — throttle tenant-7 down by 50% and evict if no improvement. I'll run eviction script.
maya: Command I would run:```
# throttle tenant
rctl tenant update --id tenant-7 --qps-limit 60 --pool evermore-euw1
# evict if needed
rctl tenant evict --id tenant-7 --pool evermore-euw1 --grace 30s
```
tilly: Go ahead Samir. I'll warm additional pool nodes in parallel. Start the hosted fallback route too (non-critical routes only).
samir: Throttle applied to tenant-7 -> qps-limit 60. Monitoring...
(30s later)
maya: p99 for pool dropped to 1.8s, tenant-7 p99->2.1s. Good signal.
tilly: Nice. Continue observation for 5m. Meanwhile prepping restarts of the 3 nodes into q4 image. Maya, can you coordinate safe restart?
maya: Starting rolling restart with drain. Command: `infractl node restart --ids node-7a,node-7b,node-7c --image redwood/runtime-q4 --drain --grace 60s`
olivia: Customer on call waiting for update. I told them we've throttled a noisy tenant and are restarting nodes; next update in 10m.
evermore-sre: Appreciate the quick action. Any ETA for full recovery?
tilly: Expect p99 under 1.0s after nodes are back and caches warm — ETA ~12-15m. We'll keep you posted.
(8m)
maya: Two nodes back on q4 image, KV cache warming. p99 now 0.92s for the pool.
samir: Third node completed restart. No further OOMs in logs.
luis: Adding note — eviction not required, throttle held. No customer errors observed post-throttle.
tilly: Ok let's start de-escalation. I'll update incident channel and create a follow-up ticket for root cause (autoscaler OOM leading to image fallback).
olivia: Scheduling a post-incident call with Evermore for RCA at 16:00 UTC. I'll include mitigation timeline.
evermore-sre: Thanks — we'll join. Please include logs around 09:00-09:20 UTC.
tilly: Follow-up tasks: [1] RCA ticket infra-6123 created; [2] add guard to autoscaler to preserve runtime flag on restart; [3] tighten p95/p99 alerts for dedicated pools; [4] produce customer incident summary. Assigning to samir/maya/luis.
samir: Taking infra-6123. Will attach autoscaler logs and node images.
maya: I'll add the node restart playbook updates.
luis: I'll coordinate status page blurb and customer summary.
tilly: Handing off to Samir for postmortem. If anything regresses, re-open this thread. Closing active mitigation — p99 within SLO. :white_check_mark:
